motions.label: Programmed upside-down get-up → learned balance
motions.description: Folds onto its back, returns the legs slowly, then uses the back get-up. This nominal example passes both timesteps. 9/10 fresh upside-down starts pass both timesteps; recovery remains experimental.
motions.limit_text: Three seconds of motor-held settling and twelve seconds for recovery. 19/20 fresh rollouts pass. This is a programmed supervisor with a learned balance endpoint, using the same four motors and 120 mm wheels. Impacts, other leg starting poses, self-contact dynamics, hardware uncertainty and reliable all-direction recovery remain unqualified.
